title.rendered: How I Transform Waste from Lagos Roads into Meaningful Art — Lagos Artist

content.rendered:
While many see waste as a nuisance, Lagos-based artist Jesutomiwa Giwa sees possibility. Using discarded materials collected from roadsides, drainage channels, and other parts of the city, he transforms items that would otherwise contribute to pollution into striking works of art that tell powerful stories.

Jesutomiwa shares his journey into creative recycling, the process behind his artwork, and how he is using art to promote environmental consciousness. Through his work, he is proving that beauty can emerge from the most unlikely places while helping to draw attention to the importance of a cleaner and more sustainable Lagos.
